title: Tour: hmrphysics.life
intro: A short look at hmrphysics.life in screenshots of the site itself, with our own words for each one. Nothing here is sent anywhere.

steps.say: Screenshots only, nothing is sent. HMR keeps every equation physics has confirmed. What it changes is the framework the equations are read in: Universal Intelligence comes first, and space, time, and matter come after.
In HMR, space, time, and matter are not the bottom layer of reality. Read that way, the open problems of physics change shape.
Established science carries a source. HMR's view is HMR's. Open means nobody has the answer yet, and the page says so in those words.
